notes: EP: the genome-wide promoter capture Hi-C sample EP_genomewide.chinput on the CHiCAGO hg19 HindIII design; K562: ENCODE K562 promoter capture Hi-C replicates 1 and 2 (HiCUP + bam2chicago on the same design). Fragment-level cools (one variable-size bin per HindIII fragment) from hicConvertFormat --inputFormat chinput, chromosomes kept with the 3.7.6 hicAdjustMatrix (derive_capture.sh). Bait-to-bait pixels hold N once (the two chinput rows of a pair carry the same N; the larger where they differ); identical input on both sides. 1,329 baits on three matrices (all of chr20-22 but ADAMTS1_423843, on which the 3.7.6 chicViewpoint of the downstream validator fails at 200 kb, see ext.chicViewpoint.EP_frag.ADAMTS1.range200000.reference_error); variable bins, so the relative positions are bins times the matrix's median bin size (2,513 bp). Position, max and mean value at E0; size and prob judged by the likelihood and downstream validators, as for the repository cases.

ENCODE K562 promoter capture Hi-C replicates 1 and 2, binned at 10 kb (fixed bins), chr20 kept with the 3.7.6 hicAdjustMatrix (derive_capture.sh). The 573 chr20 baits that pass the 3.7.6 QC; sparse data, so --truncateZeros. Position, max and mean value at E0; size and prob judged by the likelihood and downstream validators, as for the repository cases.

ENCODE K562 promoter capture Hi-C replicates 1 and 2, binned at 10 kb (fixed bins), chr20 kept with the 3.7.6 hicAdjustMatrix (derive_capture.sh). 573 QC-passed baits, --fixateRange 200000 --averageContactBin 3. Position, max and mean value at E0; size and prob judged by the likelihood and downstream validators, as for the repository cases.

EP fragment-level cool, chr1 only (64,395 bins, 8.5 M pixels); all 2,272 chr1 baits. Position, max and mean value at E0; size and prob judged by the likelihood and downstream validators, as for the repository cases.
